I got it working with

library(maps)
library(ggplot2)
library(foreign)

mundo <- (map_data("world"))
eba <- read.dbf("E:\\data.dbf") #! Warnings Renamed Columns


ggplot(eba,aes(x=EBALON,y=EBALAT))+
borders("world")+
geom_point(aes(size=N_IRRS,colour=N_ART))

Any way to put it pretty (how can I post a image)?
